about_the_game:
Four years ago, you saved the world. But not everything turned out the way you hoped – things are rarely that simple. As the consequences of your actions ripple through the lives of many, an analyst foresees the downfall of society.

Angels with Scaly Wings™, Part 2: The Strands of Fate is the sequel to the acclaimed visual novel Angels with Scaly Wings.

As the respected savior of humans and dragonkind, take on the mantle of head of the Special Threat Assessment Task Force to investigate a series of mysterious events that hint towards a sinister purpose.

Features

  • Expansive Narrative

    A complex and nuanced storyline with roughly double the word count of Angels with Scaly Wings.

  • Interpersonal Entanglements

    During your free time, meet with a variety of dragons on main and secondary character routes. Revisit old relationships and forge new ones.

  • Decisions matter

    Make difficult choices that can affect characters and the game world permanently. Face consequences that culminate in one of many different endings.

  • Lead your team

    Make the most of your limited resources to steer the investigation in the right direction. Talk to people, solve puzzles, encounter minigames and manage conflicts within your team.

  • Hidden lore

    Find codex entries that give greater context to the world, and unlock documents left behind by a mysterious benefactor.

content_descriptors.notes: The game is intended for a mature audience. There are sexual themes mentioned in dialogue a few times. One character is seen abusing alcohol once.

short_description: 4 years after the events of Angels with Scaly Wings, humans and dragons co-exist in a society built from the remains of a broken world. A new threat looms on the horizon. Re-discover this unique setting and lead an investigation in this compelling sci-fi visual novel with dating sim elements.
